text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Early one morning, I notice El Condor
Pasa
practicing dance on her own.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! What do you think? Pretty
dynamic
dance, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While the movements certainly are
dynamic, I
can't help but worry that she
might run into some
of the other
performers during concerts.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... That does make things difficult. I
usually
lose track of my surroundings
when I dance alone.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Qué?! Somewhere I can watch my
surroundings...
Like where?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... I've definitely gotta look around me in a place like this...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Geez, it takes way more strength than I
expected
to not bump into people...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But! That's exactly why I want to
challenge myself!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm the type of gal who always tries to
overcome
any obstacle! I'll get better,
no matter what!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll show you the best dancin'
you've
ever seen! Just you wait!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I see significant
improvement in
her dancing, just as she
promised.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: So I should watch myself while I dance?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I see! Just the kind of advice I expect
from you,
Trainer! That's something I can
practice by myself!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Although, looking into your own eyes
while you
dance is pretty intense!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna lose to myself! I can do
this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, El Condor Pasa practices
while gazing
at herself in the mirror until
she learns to dance
without hindering
others.
